title.en: Keep Diesel 60 Concrete Pump as printed while Seikan Tunnel only supplies the map
title.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵照印，Seikan Tunnel只当路线图

description.en: The Diesel 60 Concrete Pump note follows the outline of Seikan Tunnel. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel 60 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Diesel Engine (Power) 6105 / 144 kW; Theoretical Output 35 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵这篇笔记顺着《Seikan Tunnel》的大纲写。邢台河北品锦机械公布柴油60型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：柴油机功率6105 / 144 kW；理论输送量35 m³/h；最大出口压力30 MPa；料斗容积0.4 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直）150 m / 350 m；液压泵Kawasaki double pump 100；外形尺寸4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm；整机重量3500 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
